f3_program: collection("family.apples", "apple", "family", source("Greg and Sarah have 18 apples that they are going to split evenly. Susan has twice as many apples as Greg will end up with. Mark has 5 fewer apples than Susan."))
member("family.apples", "greg.apples", source("Greg and Sarah have 18 apples that they are going to split evenly"))
member("family.apples", "sarah.apples", source("Greg and Sarah have 18 apples that they are going to split evenly"))
member("family.apples", "susan.apples", source("Susan has twice as many apples as Greg will end up with"))
member("family.apples", "mark.apples", source("Mark has 5 fewer apples than Susan"))

partition("family.apples", at("family.apples.count", "current"), source("Greg and Sarah have 18 apples that they are going to split evenly. Susan has twice as many apples as Greg will end up with. Mark has 5 fewer apples than Susan."))
observe(at("greg_and_sarah.apples.count", "initial"), 18, "count", source("Greg and Sarah have 18 apples"))

transfer("split_apples_to_greg", "greg_and_sarah", at("greg_and_sarah.apples.count", "current"), at("greg.apples.count", "current"), fraction(at("greg_and_sarah.apples.count", "initial"), 1, 2), source("Greg and Sarah have 18 apples that they are going to split evenly"))

transfer("split_apples_to_sarah", "greg_and_sarah", at("greg_and_sarah.apples.count", "current"), at("sarah.apples.count", "current"), fraction(at("greg_and_sarah.apples.count", "initial"), 1, 2), source("Greg and Sarah have 18 apples that they are going to split evenly"))
multiple(at("susan.apples.count", "current"), event_field("split_apples_to_greg", "quantity"), 2, source("Susan has twice as many apples as Greg will end up with"))
offset(at("mark.apples.count", "current"), at("susan.apples.count", "current"), -5, "count", source("Mark has 5 fewer apples than Susan"))
observe(at("mom.apple_pie.required_apples.count", "current"), 40, "count", source("Their mom needs 40 apples to make an apple pie"))
consume("make_apple_pie", "mom", at("family.apples.count", "current"), at("mom.apple_pie.required_apples.count", "current"), source("Their mom needs 40 apples to make an apple pie"))
query("remaining_count", "family.apples", "current")
assumptions: The listed family members' apples form the pool available to the mother for the pie.

f3_program: collection("john.dog.vet_appointments", "vet_appointment", "john.dog", source("3 vet appointments"))
observe(at("john.dog.vet_appointments.count", "required"), 3, "count", source("3 vet appointments"))
member("john.dog.vet_appointments", "john.dog.vet_appointments.first", source("the first appointment"))
member("john.dog.vet_appointments", "john.dog.vet_appointments.subsequent", source("subsequent visits"))

partition("john.dog.vet_appointments", at("john.dog.vet_appointments.count", "required"), source("After the first appointment, John paid $100 for pet insurance that covers 80% of the subsequent visits"))
observe(at("john.dog.vet_appointment.cost_rate", "current"), 400, "currency_per_appointment", source("which cost $400 each"))

product_relation(at("john.dog.vet_appointments.subsequent.full_cost", "subsequent_visits"), at("john.dog.vet_appointment.cost_rate", "current"), at("john.dog.vet_appointments.subsequent.count", "subsequent_visits"), source("which cost $400 each"))
remove("pet_insurance_purchase", "john", at("john.money.amount", "current"), 100, source("John paid $100 for pet insurance"))
percent_of(at("john.pet_insurance.covered_cost", "subsequent_visits"), at("john.dog.vet_appointments.subsequent.full_cost", "subsequent_visits"), 80, source("covers 80% of the subsequent visits"))
query("value", "john.total_paid")
assumptions: “Paid in total” denotes John's out-of-pocket spending.

f3_program: collection("citrus_grove.orchards", "orchard", "citrus_grove", source("their sixteen orchards"))
observe(at("citrus_grove.orchards.count", "planned"), 16, "count", source("sixteen orchards"))
member("citrus_grove.orchards", "citrus_grove.orchards.lemons", source("Lemons, their most popular citrus fruit, will take up eight orchards"))
member("citrus_grove.orchards", "citrus_grove.orchards.oranges", source("Oranges are their second most popular fruit and will occupy half as many orchards as the lemons"))
member("citrus_grove.orchards", "citrus_grove.orchards.limes", source("Limes and grapefruits will split the remaining orchards"))
member("citrus_grove.orchards", "citrus_grove.orchards.grapefruits", source("Limes and grapefruits will split the remaining orchards"))

partition("citrus_grove.orchards", at("citrus_grove.orchards.count", "planned"), source("Lemons, their most popular citrus fruit, will take up eight orchards. Oranges are their second most popular fruit and will occupy half as many orchards as the lemons. Limes and grapefruits will split the remaining orchards."))
observe(at("citrus_grove.orchards.lemons.count", "planned"), 8, "count", source("eight orchards"))
fraction_of(at("citrus_grove.orchards.oranges.count", "planned"), at("citrus_grove.orchards.lemons.count", "planned"), 1, 2, source("half as many orchards as the lemons"))
same(at("citrus_grove.orchards.limes.count", "planned"), at("citrus_grove.orchards.grapefruits.count", "planned"), source("Limes and grapefruits will split the remaining orchards"))
query("value", at("citrus_grove.orchards.grapefruits.count", "planned"))
assumptions: “Split the remaining orchards” denotes an even split between limes and grapefruits.

f3_program: collection("family.passengers", "passenger", "family", source("A family of 4 arrives"))
observe(at("family.passengers.count", "arrival"), 4, "count", source("A family of 4 arrives"))
collection("family.oranges", "orange", "family", source("gets their oranges"))
observe(at("florida.promotion.orange_rate", "current"), 1, "orange_per_passenger", source("one orange per passenger"))

rate_relation(at("family.promotion_oranges.count", "arrival"), at("florida.promotion.orange_rate", "current"), at("family.passengers.count", "arrival"), source("every car that arrives gets one orange per passenger. A family of 4 arrives and gets their oranges"))
add("promotion_oranges", "florida", at("family.oranges.count", "current"), at("family.promotion_oranges.count", "arrival"), source("A family of 4 arrives and gets their oranges"))
observe(at("family.snack_spending.amount", "planned"), 15, "currency", source("spend $15 in total"))
same(at("family.avoided_orange_purchase.count", "stop"), at("family.promotion_oranges.count", "arrival"), source("now that they have the oranges they don't have to buy them at the stop"))
observe(at("stop.orange.price_rate", "stop"), 1.5, "currency_per_orange", source("the oranges would've cost $1.5 each"))

product_relation(at("family.savings.amount", "stop"), at("family.avoided_orange_purchase.count", "stop"), at("stop.orange.price_rate", "stop"), source("now that they have the oranges they don't have to buy them at the stop. When they get to the stop they see that the oranges would've cost $1.5 each"))
query("percentage_ratio", at("family.savings.amount", "stop"), at("family.snack_spending.amount", "planned"))
assumptions: The family of four is treated as four passengers in the arriving car.
